comments.body: [pixie.haus](http://pixie.haus) is very nice, if you don't want to set anything up, but Flux is pretty good at it

replies.author: sandacz_91
replies.body:
Wow, it’s probably first time I’m seeing someone recommending my service. Thank you very much, that made my day ^^ 

And answering OP question, try google Ai studio - new gemini flash experimental is super interesting. Also someone mentioned imagen 3 - probably now best vanilla model for detailed pixel art.

You can also try my service, new users get free credits so you can experiment a little bit. I’m doing additional postprocessing to improve pixel art quality.

replies.author: VolumeAny3775
replies.body: Signed up for your site because of this comment. I checked it out and it looks pretty good.

replies.author: sandacz_91
replies.body: And yes flux is very nice (and schnell is enough for pixel art) but it’s good to do at least resizing with nearest neighbor.
